title.narrative: Stöd till kvinnors politiska deltagande i Turkiet
Support to women's political participation Turkey - Evaluation

description.narrative: Projektet syftar till att ge stöd åt kvinnor som deltar i den turkiska politiken samt verka för fler kvinnor inom beslutsfattande mekanismer. KA.DERs arbete består bl.a. i att anordna utbildningar i politiskt deltagande med ett jämställdhetsperspektiv, där kvinnor från olika politiska partier deltar. KA.DER är också del av ett nätverk som lobbar mot diskriminerande lagstiftning i Turkiet.

The project aims to support women in their participation in politics as well as lobbying for more women in decision-making mechanisms. KA.DER organizes political schools with a gender equality perspective where women from different political parties participate. KA.DER is also part of wider networks that lobby towards reforms of discriminating laws and policies in Turkey.

The overall objective of the KA.DER Project “Increasing the Number of Women with Gender Awareness Who Are Appointed or Elected in All Decision Making Processes Program” supported by SIDA is to ensure equal representation of women and men in all fields of life and especially equal representation in all elected and appointed decision-making positions. The project aims at increasing the number of women in decision-making positions, with a focus on political parties. The idea is that such change would happen through influencing the practices of political parties, empowering women candidates, influencing legislation, making the public more gender aware - and strengthening KA.DER as an influential organization. The completion date of the project was 31st of March 2018. The project received nt is a cost extension to extend the implementation of the Project until December 31, 2018 with additional funds amounting to 1650000 SEK. The extension period covers the below results/activities: 1) Strengthening the organization’s internal structures 2) KA.DERs’ core activities: Political Schools, Campaign, Lobbying & Advocacy 3) Strengthening Woman in Local Politics: Women Muhtars Project
